## 主题或改动 / Theme or change

主题名称、设计特点及参考来源；其他类型的修改请说明解决的问题与改后行为。
Theme name, visual choices and inspirations; for other changes, describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## 预览与验证 / Preview and validation

主题贡献请附封面、章节、正文和致谢截图，包含至少一张 4:3 页面。
写出实际运行的命令（例如 `make theme-preview THEME=my-theme`）与尚未验证的部分。
For themes, attach cover, section, body and closing previews, including a 4:3 page.
List commands actually run and remaining limitations.

- [ ] 已检查两种比例的预览，或说明未完成的验证 / Both ratios reviewed, or gaps stated.
- [ ] 主题 README 已说明素材来源、许可或授权状态、字体依赖和实际设计参考 / Sources, rights status, fonts and inspirations documented.
- [ ] 未提交私人汇报、生成产物或本地环境 / No private talks, build outputs or local environments.

主题目录之外的图库、打包与发布接入由维护者协助完成；其他代码改动请附相关测试结果。
Maintainers help with gallery, packaging and release integration; other code changes should include relevant test results.
